## Acceptance evidence
- [ ] Scope and prerequisites checked against current main and deployed versions separately
- [ ] Lint, unit tests and applicable integration/build tests run (provide commands/logs)
- [ ] Wrong-user/auth, secrets, resource/quotas and failure modes reviewed
- [ ] Numerical/physical reference or baseline validated if scientific behavior changes
- [ ] Backward compatibility, schema migration and rollback noted
- [ ] Reproducible example, source commit, versions and limitations documented
- [ ] Sensitive identifiers, credentials, keys and private datasets excluded
- [ ] Live acceptance **not** claimed solely from source CI

Provide exact sanitized evidence, changes to external dependencies and any required human approval.
